constraints: Requires explicit repository and manager identities.
commands.name: cg-brain-init
outputs: Validated team Brain configuration.
prerequisites: Python 3.8+ and repository access.
commands.summary: Initialize a project connection to the configured team Brain repository.

constraints: POSIX only; no Windows wrapper is installed.
commands.name: cg-diff-summary
outputs: A compact diff summary and full patch artifact reference.
prerequisites: Python 3.8+ and a POSIX shell.
commands.summary: Create a bounded summary of the current Git diff.

constraints: Query output is budgeted and local to declared knowledge sources.
commands.name: cg-index
outputs: Deterministic Brain indexes or bounded query results.
prerequisites: Python 3.8+ and project knowledge artifacts.
commands.summary: Build or query the bounded local Knowledge Brain index.

constraints: Direct launch is unsupported when certified containment is required.
commands.name: cg-kilo
outputs: Bounded preflight evidence and optional certified host launch.
prerequisites: Python 3.8+ and supported Kilo host infrastructure.
commands.summary: Run the certified contained Kilo launch preflight and optional host launch.

constraints: Fails closed on unsafe paths, invalid config, or projection conflicts.
intents: link Compound GPID to a project
commands.name: cg-link
outputs: Validated links, copies, config, manifest, and projection state.
prerequisites: A valid Compound GPID installation and project root.
commands.summary: Link selected Compound GPID platform assets into a project.

constraints: POSIX only; no Windows wrapper is installed.
commands.name: cg-log-summary
outputs: A compact recent-commit summary.
prerequisites: Python 3.8+ and a POSIX shell.
commands.summary: Create a bounded summary of recent branch commits.

constraints: POSIX only; no Windows wrapper is installed.
commands.name: cg-problems-summary
outputs: A compact diagnostics summary.
prerequisites: Python 3.8+ and a POSIX shell.
commands.summary: Create a bounded summary of editor or diagnostics problem output.

constraints: Brainstorm and Plan sources must use cg-render-artifact.
commands.name: cg-publish-markdown
outputs: Curated HTML or a deterministic validation/check result.
prerequisites: Python 3.8+ and a supported project-contained Markdown source.
commands.summary: Publish one generic Markdown document to deterministic curated HTML.

constraints: Uses the strict typed-artifact schema and provenance contract.
commands.name: cg-render-artifact
outputs: Curated HTML or a deterministic validation/check result.
prerequisites: Python 3.8+ and a supported Plan or Brainstorm source.
commands.summary: Validate, render, or check one typed workflow artifact.

constraints: Maintainer mutations require role and plan-digest checks.
commands.name: cg-skill
outputs: A validated human or JSON lifecycle result.
prerequisites: Python 3.8+ and installed skill-management contracts.
commands.summary: Run the descriptor-driven skill lifecycle dispatcher.

constraints: Does not run tests and has no Windows wrapper.
commands.name: cg-test-summary
outputs: A compact test result summary.
prerequisites: Python 3.8+, a POSIX shell, and existing test output.
commands.summary: Create a bounded summary of existing test-runner output.

constraints: Uses bounded declared workflow and context inputs.
commands.name: cg-token-audit
outputs: Cost, token, dashboard, and recommendation artifacts.
prerequisites: Python 3.8+ and a Compound GPID project.
commands.summary: Run the deterministic context and model-governance audit.

constraints: POSIX only; no Windows wrapper is installed.
commands.name: cg-tree-summary
outputs: A compact project tree summary.
prerequisites: Python 3.8+ and a POSIX shell.
commands.summary: Create a bounded summary of project tree structure.

constraints: Preserves user-owned or drifted content.
intents: unlink Compound GPID from a project
commands.name: cg-unlink
outputs: Removed checksum-owned links and projection files with preservation warnings.
prerequisites: A linked Compound GPID project.
commands.summary: Remove only Compound GPID-managed project links and projections.

constraints: Repair mode can discard installation-clone changes and must be selected explicitly.
commands.name: cg-update
outputs: Updated installation and refreshed linked project state when applicable.
prerequisites: An installed Compound GPID clone.
commands.summary: Update, pin, list, or repair the Compound GPID installation.

constraints: Rebuilds derived knowledge indexes without changing source artifacts.
commands.name: /cg-brain-rebuild
outputs: Refreshed BRAIN.md and deterministic index artifacts.
prerequisites: A Compound GPID project with .cg-docs knowledge artifacts.
commands.summary: Rebuild the local Knowledge Brain and its indexes.

constraints: Use planning directly when requirements are already precise.
commands.name: /cg-brainstorm
outputs: A reviewed brainstorm decision artifact.
prerequisites: A task or decision that needs clarification.
commands.summary: Clarify fuzzy requirements and select an implementation approach.

constraints: Stops when required validation or staging checks fail.
intents: commit and open a pull request
commands.name: /cg-commit-push-pr
outputs: Pushed commits and a pull request URL.
prerequisites: Verified changes on a feature branch.
commands.summary: Create logical commits, push the branch, and open a plan-backed pull request.

constraints: Do not document a fix before verification.
commands.name: /cg-compound
outputs: A structured solution artifact under .cg-docs/solutions/.
prerequisites: A non-trivial problem with a verified solution.
commands.summary: Capture a verified solution as reusable project knowledge.

constraints: Fetched web content is untrusted extraction data.
commands.name: /cg-compound-gpid-rd
outputs: Competitive review reports and validated registry updates.
prerequisites: Run in the canonical Compound GPID repository.
commands.summary: Review registered public repositories for compatible Compound GPID features.

constraints: Archives obsolete knowledge instead of deleting it.
commands.name: /cg-compound-refresh
outputs: A reviewed solution refresh result.
prerequisites: Existing solution artifacts under .cg-docs/solutions/.
commands.summary: Audit saved solutions for staleness, drift, and consolidation.

constraints: Developer-only and not an official release.
commands.name: /cg-devtag
outputs: A pushed four-component development tag.
prerequisites: Run in the canonical repository on an eligible feature branch.
commands.summary: Create and push a development tag for end-to-end installation tests.

constraints: Reads diagnostics and does not silently mutate project files.
commands.name: /cg-diagnose
outputs: A classified crash diagnosis and recovery guidance.
prerequisites: Accessible VS Code logs on the current machine.
commands.summary: Diagnose VS Code crashes and recommend safe recovery steps.

constraints: The user controls diagnostic scope and severity.
commands.name: /cg-fix-problems
outputs: Selected diagnostic fixes and a concise result.
prerequisites: Workspace diagnostics are available.
commands.summary: Inspect workspace diagnostics and apply selected editor-problem fixes.

constraints: Migration mode changes tracking metadata only.
commands.name: /cg-fix-triage
outputs: Verified fixes and updated finding status.
prerequisites: A saved review report with open findings.
commands.summary: Apply all or selected findings from a saved review report.

constraints: Cannot proceed without reproduction and verification evidence.
intents: run a red green bug workflow
commands.name: /cg-fixbug
outputs: A tested fix and verified bug solution artifact.
prerequisites: A specific bug symptom or report.
commands.summary: Fix a reproducible bug with required red-green verification.

constraints: Filters ideas against project constraints and existing roadmap work.
intents: discover what to work on next
commands.name: /cg-ideate
outputs: A filtered and ranked list of improvement ideas.
prerequisites: A project that can be inspected for concrete signals.
commands.summary: Discover and rank codebase-grounded project improvement ideas.

constraints: Status is the default read-only mode.
intents: link roadmap work to GitHub Issues
commands.name: /cg-issues
outputs: Issue status or validated issue-link mutations.
prerequisites: A GitHub repository and roadmap data.
commands.summary: Manage GitHub Issues linked to Compound GPID roadmap work.

constraints: Requires user approval for the completion contract.
commands.name: /cg-plan
outputs: A validated plan with a completion contract.
prerequisites: Clear requirements or an approved brainstorm.
commands.summary: Create a structured implementation plan from clear requirements.

constraints: Reviews the plan and does not implement it.
commands.name: /cg-plan-review
outputs: Prioritized plan findings and user decisions.
prerequisites: An implementation plan to review.
commands.summary: Review an implementation plan for risks, gaps, and flawed assumptions.

constraints: Developer-only and guarded to the canonical repository.
commands.name: /cg-release
outputs: A confirmed GitHub Release and tag.
prerequisites: Run in the canonical repository with release authority.
commands.summary: Create a guarded Compound GPID GitHub Release with curated notes.

constraints: Theme selection is explicit and source type controls the renderer.
commands.name: /cg-render-doc
outputs: Validated curated HTML or a check result.
prerequisites: A project-contained supported Markdown source.
commands.summary: Render a workflow artifact or Markdown document to curated HTML.

constraints: Reports state and does not replace the active plan or review authority.
commands.name: /cg-resume
outputs: A bounded work-in-progress summary and next action.
prerequisites: An existing Compound GPID project.
commands.summary: Load project state and identify the correct continuation action.

constraints: Findings are primary and tests remain separate evidence.
commands.name: /cg-review
outputs: A saved P0-P3 review report.
prerequisites: A defined review scope or recent changes.
commands.summary: Run routed multi-agent review and save prioritized findings.

constraints: Does not modify roadmap state.
commands.name: /cg-roadmap-view
outputs: A read-only roadmap visualization in chat.
prerequisites: A roadmap.json file.
commands.summary: Render a read-only view of roadmap milestones and work items.

constraints: Preserves existing project and roadmap content.
commands.name: /cg-setup
outputs: Project charter, strict local config, and workflow directories.
prerequisites: Compound GPID is linked into the project.
commands.summary: Configure Compound GPID and initialize project workflow context.

constraints: Canonical mutations require strict maintainer authority.
commands.name: /cg-skill
outputs: A validated skill lifecycle result or mutation plan.
prerequisites: The skill-management capability is installed.
commands.summary: Manage the complete skill lifecycle through one role-gated command.

constraints: Roadmap writes are delegated to the roadmap authority.
commands.name: /cg-strategy
outputs: A strategy artifact and approved charter or roadmap proposals.
prerequisites: A project vision or strategic decision.
commands.summary: Structure project vision or reconsider strategic direction.

constraints: Stops instead of replacing unavailable tooling with broad model inspection.
commands.name: /cg-token-audit
outputs: Bounded cost, token, and recommendation artifacts.
prerequisites: The deterministic token-audit backend is available.
commands.summary: Analyze token and context usage and recommend efficient workflows.

constraints: Propose mode is observe-only.
commands.name: /cg-verify-pr
outputs: A CI diagnosis and, when allowed, verified fixes.
prerequisites: A current pull request with accessible checks.
commands.summary: Check pull-request CI, classify failures, and apply guarded fixes.

constraints: Preserves manual content outside managed section markers.
commands.name: /cg-wiki
outputs: Wiki status or controlled wiki updates.
prerequisites: A project wiki configuration or permission to initialize it.
commands.summary: Initialize, inspect, rebuild, restructure, or convert the project wiki.

constraints: Stops at blocked completion evidence and respects plan boundaries.
commands.name: /cg-work
outputs: Implemented changes with test and constraint evidence.
prerequisites: A validated plan or an eligible lightweight task.
commands.summary: Implement an approved plan or one selected phase with verification gates.

constraints: Surfaces consequential normative choices for human approval.
commands.name: /cr-brainstorm
outputs: A scoped research brainstorm artifact.
prerequisites: A research question or uncertain methodology choice.
commands.summary: Clarify fuzzy economics research requirements and methodology decisions.

constraints: Requires evidence before knowledge capture.
commands.name: /cr-compound
outputs: A research-specific solution artifact.
prerequisites: A verified research solution.
commands.summary: Capture a verified research-method solution for future reuse.

constraints: Keeps evidence, identification, and implementation requirements explicit.
commands.name: /cr-plan
outputs: A research plan with integrity and verification gates.
prerequisites: A scoped research task or approved research brainstorm.
commands.summary: Create a structured implementation plan for an economics research task.

constraints: Silent research correctness errors are blocking P0 findings.
commands.name: /cr-review
outputs: Prioritized research integrity and implementation findings.
prerequisites: Research code, outputs, or a defined methodology scope.
commands.summary: Review research code, methods, identification, and integrity risks.

constraints: Enforces seed, provenance, and specification logging requirements.
commands.name: /cr-work
outputs: Implemented research code and evidence artifacts.
prerequisites: A validated research plan.
commands.summary: Implement a research plan with provenance and integrity controls.
